brief_summary: A do/don't two-column map. The amber 'Good fit for' column lists wants ambient per-key glow, fine with a 65% layer-tap workflow, and patient secondhand hunting. The warm-red 'Skip it for' column lists wants max aluminum heft and resonance, needs a dedicated function row, and wants every part ordered new today — mirroring the article's who-should-skip-this-build paragraph.
